attacks.name: Cell Storm
attacks.text: Discard 2 Psychic Energy attached to this Pokémon and remove 6 damage counters from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Time Rewind
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck.

attacks.name: Volcano Stomp
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard the top 4 cards of your opponent's deck. If tails, discard the top 4 cards of your deck.

attacks.name: Scorching Wing
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard all Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Destructive Tsunami
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. If tails, this attack does 40 damage to each of your Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Miasma Wind
attacks.text: Does 50 damage times the number of Special Conditions affecting the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sooting Scent
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Dimension Sphere
attacks.text: Does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each of your Pokémon in the Lost Zone.

attacks.name: Sky Uppercut
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

attacks.name: Linear Attack
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Self-Generation
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench, you may attach up to 2 Lightning Energy cards from your hand to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Shocking Bolt
attacks.text: Put all Energy cards attached to this Pokémon in the Lost Zone.

attacks.name: Wormhole
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. Then, your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Inferno Spear
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy and a Lightning Energy attached to this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Trick Reveal
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may have both you and your opponent reveal your hands. This power can't be used if this Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Juggling
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Layabout
attacks.text: Remove all damage counters from this Pokémon. This Pokémon can't use Layabout during your next turn.

attacks.name: Clomp Clomp Clobber
attacks.text: Put 1 Energy card attached to this Pokémon in the Lost Zone.

attacks.name: Grind
attacks.text: Does 20 damage times the number of Energy attached to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Plow Over
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, put 1 Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon in the Lost Zone.

attacks.name: Swords Dance
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Lost Claw attack's base damage is 80.

attacks.name: Lost Claw
attacks.text: Choose 1 card from your opponent's hand without looking and put it in the Lost Zone.

abilities.name: Sweet Sleeping Face
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is Asleep, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks.

attacks.name: Sleepy Lost
attacks.text: Put the top card of your opponent's deck in the Lost Zone. This Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Tumble Over
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

attacks.name: Poison Buildup
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Poison Effect
attacks.text: If this Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 20 damage plus 60 more damage and remove the Special Condition Poisoned from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Nap
attacks.text: Remove 1 damage counter from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Fireworks
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard a Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon.

abilities.name: Ultra-Thick Skin
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon has Energy attached to it, any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Rock Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage.

attacks.name: Prehistoric Wisdom
attacks.text: Choose a card from your hand and put it in the Lost Zone. Then, draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Granite Head
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Whismy Tackle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Nutritional Support
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Grass Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Poisonpowder
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Fake Tears
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't play any Trainer cards from their hand during your opponent's next turn, and any damage done to this Pokémon by attack is reduced by 30 (after applying weakness and resistance).

attacks.name: Aqua Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each heads.

cards.name: Lost Remover
cards.text: Put 1 Special Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon in the Lost Zone.

cards.name: Lost World
cards.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card. Once during each player's turn, if that player's opponent has 6 or more Pokémon in the Lost Zone, the player may choose to win the game.

cards.name: Research Record
cards.text: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck and put as many of them as you like back on top of your deck in any order. Then, put the remaining cards on the bottom of your deck in any order.
